rules.basis: Operator holds CIPHERTEXT only (cannot read it); ciphertext blob deleted after the window. Delivery/continuity purpose.
Ephemeral channels: operator retains no ciphertext; only the participants' devices hold it (their own disclosed policy).
Minimisation default: presence is ephemeral, not logged over time.
Employment record: kept for the employment relationship; erasure may be overridden by an independent legal-obligation (document in ROPA).
Accountability of admin acts (legal-obligation / legitimate-interest). Append-only + tamper-evident; employee-visible.
Active managed configuration; removed when the device is deprovisioned.
